title: Spicy Udon Noodles
description: A spicy and savory Japanese noodle dish made with udon noodles, vegetables, and a flavorful sauce. This recipe is a perfect blend of spicy and sweet flavors.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the udon noodles according to the package instructions.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the sesame oil and soy sauce and stir-fry for another minute.
Add the cooked udon noodles and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until well coated with the sauce.
Add the sesame seeds and chopped green onions and stir-fry for another minute.
Add the spicy sauce and stir-fry for another minute.
Serve hot and garnish with additional sesame seeds and green onions if desired.
